svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: what else is on the workbench? godotion (GDScript, 1 star): A motion-graphics timeline editor plugin for Godot 4. Scene nodes become tracks, drawn with Godot's own editor icons and theme. Q: any GitHub stats? 1,400 contributions, 6 mo, 90 active days, 13 days, best streak, 142 on the busiest day This week so far: 28 contributions and 0 pull request events. Q: what's in Sand's stack? languages TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, Bash, C++ frontend React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js backend Node.js, Express, FastAPI, WebSockets, Firebase, Stripe desktop Electron, electron-vite, electron-builder, hardened IPC testing Vitest, Playwright, pytest, Testing Library, ESLint devops GitHub Act…
